_description: Machine-readable pin ledger for Xbox 360 SHIFT ReXGlue host artifacts. Read by tools/xbox360/build/verify_pins.py. Every entry records what produced an artifact and confirms its SHA-256 as seen during the noted verification pass.
_rules: status=verified means sha256sum was recomputed on this host during verified_on and matched sha256.
status=unverified means the claimed value was NOT recomputed on this host; do not cite it as fact.
status=unavailable means the artifact file is absent locally; verify_pins.py reports it and does not fail.
status=mismatch is produced by verify_pins.py at check time, never written by hand.
Build outputs are never committed. Only hashes, source commits and the recipe are tracked.
